MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.

Jordan A. Lavinsky, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff, Emorium Mall LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability Company.
No appearance by defaulted defendant(s) Charles Siegel and Shabana Siegel.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
Jason Kapuscinski sworn and examinded on behalf of Plaintiff.
After Evidence and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against Defaulted Defendant(s) as follows:

Damages: $2,246,976.99
Pre-Judgment Interest at the annual rate of 6.25%: $245,089.79
Costs: $470.00
Total Judgment in the amount of $2,492,536.78

Other (speicify): Plaintiff shall give defendants credit for rents received in connection with store No. 490 from September 1, 2013 through January 31, 2021.
Judgment signed in open court.
